name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
prevention: Never compile or render untrusted data as template source; use static templates and pass untrusted data only as values
trigger_keywords: ssti template injection jinja2 twig freemarker ejs pug nunjucks

name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic
prevention: Define typed allowlist schemas and construct data-store queries server-side; never accept client-controlled query logic
trigger_keywords: nosql nosqli mongodb elasticsearch redis cassandra operator query filter
